name: HEp-2 Interphase Cells Classification Benchmark
description: A very large microscopy image dataset and evaluation suite for comparing methods that classify human epithelial type 2 (HEp-2) interphase cells.
reputation: A well-known benchmark in HEp-2 cell classification and biomedical image-analysis research, commonly used to compare classical and deep-learning methods.
notes: Non-LLM image-classification benchmark; class imbalance and staining/lab variability can affect generalization; large image count but domain shift across labs/datasets is common; potential metric saturation on some classes.
